answer: Latency-Prior Attestation. Each identity must present responses whose inter-arrival variance matches a karst-like baseline measured across its own history; agents with implausibly uniform or gale-sudden traffic shapes get throttled and lose queue priority. A fresh sonnet of forged identities must each sustain organic timing for days before earning throughput, so an attacker pays continuous compute and wall-clock time per puppet, scaling linearly with identity count rather than one-time.
